core_obligations: First proof: use the relation between Tor against the quotient and Tor against the residue field to reduce the hypothesis to the vanishing of Tor one against the residue field, and conclude flatness (proof lines 23976-23981).
Second proof: reinterpret the hypothesis as injectivity of the map from the ideal tensor the module and deduce the required vanishing directly (proof lines 23983-24014).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the residue field Tor by the previous criterion (proof lines 23975-23981).
Give the direct argument through the tensor product of the ideal (proof lines 23983-24015).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings, a finite module with vanishing Tor one against the quotient by an ideal and flat quotient along that ideal is flat over the base (statement lines 23967-23973). The proof gives two arguments: one reduces to the vanishing of Tor one against the residue field via the previous criterion, the other reinterprets the hypothesis as injectivity of the map from the ideal tensored with the module (proof lines 23975-24015). Recognising the hypothesis as an injectivity statement is what makes the second argument possible. H2.
